attchmntText: Amagi Media Labs Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Amagi and Golden Times Media Technology to Bring Chinese Entertainment Channels to Global Platforms.".
voiceSummary: Amagi Media Labs Limited has issued a press release dated November 12, 2026, announcing a partnership with Golden Times Media Technology to bring Chinese entertainment channels to global platforms. The collaboration involves adding four technology channels, specifically Drama Short, Chinese Kung Fu, AniVerse, and C Drama+, to the Amagi CONNECT marketplace. This initiative aims to make these channels available for discovery by streaming, FAST, and CTV platforms worldwide. Golden Times Media Technology, listed on the Beijing Stock Exchange under stock code 920021.BJ, plans to introduce additional content, including movie, cycling, and food channels, in the future. The disclosure is submitted pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Amagi Media Labs Limited has informed the Exchange about Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP
Amagi Media Labs Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of Mr. Prasad Menon as Chief People Officer of the company w.e.f. December 31, 2026.
voiceSummary: Amagi Media Labs Limited disclosed the resignation of Mr. Prasad Menon, Chief People Officer and Senior Management Personnel. He tendered his resignation via letter dated November 11, 2026, citing personal exigencies. The company accepted the resignation. His cessation from the role is effective from the close of business hours on December 31, 2026. The company expressed appreciation for his contributions. It has initiated the process to identify a suitable successor for the position. The company is currently evaluating appropriate candidates for the role. This information is filed pursuant to SEBI LODR Regulations.
